{{Top|leg}}
The '''over-council''' was part of the government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalzeron]]. The over-council issued a formal charter that decreed that those [[Kalzerian]]s who had retreated off-world to form a resistance against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] occupation were traitors to their nation.
